findings.title: Spec 001 is still marked Draft although it is implemented
findings.why: The code and tests for task ids are in the change. The other specs (002–004) are marked Implemented, and tasks.md ticks every item for 001.

findings.title: Plan names an outdated createTask signature
findings.why: The plan says `createTask(input, id)`. The code has `createTask(input, id, now)` at src/domain/task.ts:99. The plan also says `resolve(ref)`, which does not exist: the lookup function in list.ts is `find`.

findings.title: Non-null assertion on the id lookup
findings.why: `byId.get(id)!` relies on `idOf` and `byId` always agreeing. The maps are kept in step by hand, so a future bug in one would show up as a crash here. A single title-to-task index, or a guarded lookup, would avoid the assertion.
